nina (docs): Quick note: the Generate API doc shows `max_tokens` default = 256 in the parameter table, but runtime uses 1024 if omitted. A customer hit this when switching from our older examples and was surprised by longer outputs and cost.

sam (eng-runtime): You're right. We bumped the runtime default to 1024 last year to reduce truncation. Should have coordinated the docs change.

jules (sdk): SDK examples also assume 256 in some of our quickstart snippets. We should update examples + add a short migration note that default increased.

nina (docs): Proposal: update parameter table to say `Default: 1024 (was 256 before 2026-01-15)` and add a short FAQ blurb: "Why did my responses get longer?" with guidance to set `max_tokens` explicitly. Also update the curl and JS snippets to set `max_tokens` explicitly in the quickstart.

sam (eng-runtime): Fine with docs-only change. No runtime rollback. If we expect user confusion, we could add a short banner on the Generate page.

jules (sdk): I'll open a tiny SDK patch to make quickstart explicit: `client.generate({ model, input, max_tokens: 256 })` so tutorials behave deterministically. Then we can bump examples later to show best-practice (explicit max or streaming).

nina (docs): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978 — changes param table, adds a migration note and updates curl/js snippets.

ci-bot: PR opened by nina -> docs#978 (CI: docs-lint ✅, link-check pending).

sam (eng-runtime): Can you also add a short note in the param description why we use 1024 by default (to reduce accidental truncation for long prompts)? Helpful context for users.

nina (docs): Added that sentence. Also added a one-line example showing how to explicitly limit tokens for cost control.

jules (sdk): SDK PR opened to set example to explicit 256 in quickstart -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/534 . Unit tests unaffected.

ci-bot: SDK PR created (CI: unit-tests passing).

nina (docs): Merged docs PR after link-check. Deployed to staging. Will promote after SDK snippet release to avoid doc/example mismatch.

jules (sdk): Merged SDK snippet PR and published patch. Quickstarts now include `max_tokens` explicitly.

sam (eng-runtime): Thanks all. I'll add an internal note to avoid future silent default changes.

nina (docs): Closing thread. If anyone spots older examples still showing 256 implicitly, ping me and I'll sweep the docs.
